<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="welcome-to-pvme" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Welcome to PvME!</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>PvM Encyclopedia is a collection of resources for RuneScape combat. This channel introduces you to how our guide and text channels are organised and presented.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="getting-involved-in-pvme"><nowiki>Getting Involved in PvME</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>It's important to note that </nowiki><strong><nowiki>PvME is open source</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>everyone who wants to contribute is welcome</nowiki></strong><nowiki>. Regardless of your combat skill level, the editing team would love to have you! Check out &lt;id:customize&gt; and select Entry Editor</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="navigating-pvme"><nowiki>Navigating PvME</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Text channels - Interact with other PvME users in these channels.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>

<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The rest of the server consists of information channels and guides.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use the </nowiki><code><nowiki>/guides</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎command to find specific guide channels. Take note to use it in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#bot-commands</nowiki></span><nowiki> and </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>NOT</nowiki></ins></strong><nowiki> social channels. Other methods of searching the server include:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>Ctrl + K</nowiki></ins></strong><nowiki> Discord function.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span><nowiki>#directory</nowiki></span><nowiki> which lists all channels currently maintained in PvME.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you've exhausted all the other options, ask in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help</nowiki></span><nowiki> for help.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="pvm-help"><ins><nowiki>PVM Help</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Link: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help</nowiki></span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help-forums</nowiki></span></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Ask all questions related to PVM or combat in these channels frequented by </nowiki><code style="color: #000000"><nowiki>@Helper</nowiki></code><nowiki>s. They will likely know the answers to your questions or direct you to the relevant guide.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Some tips on channel usage:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ask quick questions </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help</nowiki></span><nowiki>. When there's an ongoing conversation which may bury your question, try using a thread or post it in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help-forums</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Make a forum post in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help-forums</nowiki></span><nowiki> for complex questions requiring large amounts of information, e.g. preset help, understanding fundamentals of a style or boss.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>To help with commonly asked questions, we introduced commands. These should be used in the </nowiki><span><nowiki>#bot-commands</nowiki></span><nowiki> channel to provide some quick information on a variety of topics. A list of commands can be found in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#command-info</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="vod-review"><ins><nowiki>VOD Review</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Link: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#vod-reviews</nowiki></span></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><span><nowiki>#vod-reviews</nowiki></span><nowiki> allows you to submit recordings of your PVM encounters for others to review and give constructive, personalised, and judgement-free feedback. It is a great way to improve your PVM.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>To make a forum post in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#vod-reviews</nowiki></span><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Name it appropriately, e.g. &quot;&lt;Boss&gt; (&lt;Style&gt;) - RSN&quot;.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Include relevant background information and/or questions.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Include a link to your video recording.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="bossing-path"><ins><nowiki>Bossing Path</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Link: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#bossing-path</nowiki></span></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The PvME bossing path provides an avenue to progress your skills and reach higher-tier PvM goals. It helps set objectives based on learning stages to measure your progression. It's perfect if you're new to bossing and unsure of where to start or looking for objectives to facilitate advancing your current abilities.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="the-mastery-system"><ins><nowiki>The Mastery System</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Link: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The PvME Mastery System is a great way to gauge your PvM progress. It provides meaningful goals to shoot for as you learn new content or hone your skills at familiar encounters. There are multiple tiers of mastery ranks, each one granting its own unique role colour for all to see.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="pvme-boss-guides"><ins><nowiki>PvME Boss Guides</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The focus of our community is providing the best text guides possible for every encounter and players of all skill levels. Described below is the general composition of our guides. Each guide contains a table of contents at the bottom, with links to help you navigate the guide quickly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="headerbanner"><nowiki>Header/Banner</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Each guide contains a header or &quot;banner&quot; image, containing a few key pieces of information for each encounter. An example is show below for Osseous, the Rex Matriarch:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/EVLnU655gq.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>In order of circles shown in the above example:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Numbers represent the boss' size (for example 5x5 tiles)</nowiki></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> indicates whether the SGB special attack can be used</nowiki></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Note: it is recommended to </nowiki><ins><nowiki>not</nowiki></ins><nowiki> use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on a boss with size 1x1 or 2x2</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289714229258.png?v=1" alt="venomblood" title="venomblood" kind="icon" /><nowiki> indicates whether the boss is poisonable or not</nowiki></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1" alt="Summoning" title="Summoning" kind="icon" /><nowiki> indicates whether a familiar will be able to do damage to the boss</nowiki></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Slayer perks (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayerperk" title="undeadslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> undead, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1" alt="demonslayerperk" title="demonslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> demon and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502927731163170.png?v=1" alt="dragonslayerperk" title="dragonslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> dragon) indicate a boss' weakness</nowiki></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Note: when added as Invention perks to your gear, these will increase damage dealt to the boss by 7% and generally do not stack</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="suggested-presets"><nowiki>Suggested Presets</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ PvME provides one or more suggested preset(s) in every strategy guide.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Historically, presets were presented as images with a link to a full breakdown of the items used.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Since the creation of </nowiki>[https://pvme.github.io/preset-maker/ <nowiki>https://pvme.github.io/preset-maker/</nowiki>]<nowiki>, PvME is in the process of converting presets to a more condensed format, complete with familiars, relics, and more.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Examples of both formats can be found below.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Presets </nowiki><em><nowiki>usually</nowiki></em><nowiki> </nowiki><ins><nowiki>DO NOT</nowiki></ins><nowiki> need to be strictly copied.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Downgrading a little bit is usually fine.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If a boss guide that has strict gear requirements that </nowiki><strong><nowiki>must</nowiki></strong><nowiki> be adhered to, it will be clearly stated.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>If unsure, ask questions relating to presets and their contents in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Presets in full boss guides generally assume best in slot perks listed in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perks</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Presets in basic and AFK boss guides generally assume basic perks listed in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perks</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Downgrading your preset from the recommended may mean that rotations will need some extra improvisation.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Preset format example (Ranged HM Vorkath)</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=89be7288-9811-4c96-8f4c-9a992d38b458 <nowiki>Ranged</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F89be7288-9811-4c96-8f4c-9a992d38b458.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ On task, prefer blue dragon / dragon cluster tasks to undead, which is depleted by minion kills</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Highest task count is blue dragons</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayer" title="undeadslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayerperk" title="undeadslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> used</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1" alt="hellhoundpouch" title="hellhoundpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1" alt="powderofprotection" title="powderofprotection" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for sustain</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ T100 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418218264694954.png?v=1" alt="shardofgenesisessence" title="shardofgenesisessence" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697042755584.png?v=1" alt="jasdragonbanearrow" title="jasdragonbanearrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on Vorkath and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1" alt="fularrow" title="fularrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on Zemouregal</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as needed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The following are </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> needed: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / phyical </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1" alt="eq4" title="eq4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1" alt="genocidal" title="genocidal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1" alt="wenarrows" title="wenarrows" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="mechanics-suggested-ability-rotations"><nowiki>Mechanics &amp; Suggested Ability Rotations</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Following basic information and preset suggestions, guides will generally mention:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Specific boss mechanics.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• DPS ability rotations.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>The rotations listed in full boss guides are designed for optimal kills!</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Some considerations to take when following these are:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Abilities used to deal with specific mechanics </nowiki><strong><nowiki>should be adhered to strictly</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Most DPS rotations are generally only suggestions and need not be followed exactly</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Feel free to adapt them as you see fit!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Due to RNG you may need to improvise these rotations based on damage dealt, adrenaline etc.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Many of our guides make use of abbreviations. Check them out in this document: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Glossary <nowiki>https://runescape.wiki/w/Glossary</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
